Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 6
Reason for Mistake: The Planner prematurely concluded that Zurracapote contains gin (or that vodka is an interchangeable stand-in) without evidence. They overgeneralized from sources that either listed vodka (NYT) or mentioned unspecified “other alcoholic beverages” (snippets) and did not verify any source explicitly listing gin as an ingredient. This misinterpretation and assumption led to the incorrect final answer “Yes,” when the evidence supports that Gibson contains gin but Zurracapote typically does not.
